text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of Tanino Gimlet's debut race—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's boiling... my blood boils...!
An unprecedented impulse for destruction overflows within me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
World, savor this to your heart's content!
And tremble!
Before the first hoofprints carved by I, myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Far from being nervous, Tanino Gimlet is overflowing with tremendous vitality. It seems there's no need to worry after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, you have nothing to worry about.
Everything is in order.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Fulfill your duties as a Trainer
and observe my running closely."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This may be the beginning, but—
it is merely just the beginning, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—I-I actually came.
All the way to Sapporo... to watch Senpai's debut race...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
M-My heart's pounding so fast~~...
It's not even like I'm the one running,
so why am I this nervous...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, Gim-senpai...!!
Show us some crazy cool running!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin. O you who run in the same era as I.
Shall we not paint each other's destinies in full, vibrant color?!
